title: God Mode AI leak enables free local access to 50+ AI tools
description: A leaked HTML file on GitHub provides free, local access to over 50 AI tools, including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Grok, all consolidated in one interface called "God Mode." This setup runs entirely in the browser without requiring login or subscriptions, ensuring user data stays on the device. A standout feature, Classic Mode, lets users enter a single prompt and receive comparative answers from four different AI models simultaneously, enhancing response quality through competition. This innovation streamlines AI tool accessibility while prioritizing privacy and ease of use. By enabling head-to-head AI comparisons in a lightweight, offline environment, it offers practical value for users seeking efficient, cost-free AI assistance. #ChatGPT #ClaudeAI #GeminiAI #GrokAI #GodModeAI #AIAggregator #AItools #OpenSourceAI #LocalAI #ClassicMode #AICollaboration #PrivacyFirstAI #AIAccessibility #LeakedHTML #AIcomparison
